newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE applies to MOF to list Oriental Land on Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: TSE applies to MOF to list Oriental Land on Dec 11.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Thursday that it had applied to the Ministry of Finance (MOF) to list shares of Tokyo Disneyland operator Oriental Land Co Ltd on December 11.
The application was for listing on the first section of the exchange, the TSE said in a statement.
It said Oriental Land would publicly offer 17 million shares and that shareholders of Oriental Land would separately sell six million shares.
The statement said Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd, would sell 5.5 million Oriental Land shares and a group company of Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd 500,000 shares.
Mitsui Fudosan said recently that it owns 31.78 million shares of Oriental Land, with a book value of 2.1 billion yen.

Oriental Land said recently that it was owned 38.23 percent by Mitsui Fudosan, 25.4 precent by Keisei Electric Railway group company Keisei Toshi Kaihatsu, and 13.4 percent by Keisei Electric Railway.

The TSE said Oriental Land would hold a tender on November 27 to sell 11.5 million shares, or half the total number of shares to be offered. Applications for the tender must be made on November 26, it said.
The selling price of the remaining 11.5 million shares would reflect the outcome of the tender, a TSE official said.
Applications for these 11.5 million shares must be made between December 2 and 4, while payment must be made on December 10 for delivery the following day, he said.
